value.name: Asha waits before opening bag
value.description: Asha waits until the dome light dims, then opens the bag at her hip and prepares documents.
evidence: waited until the dome light dimmed before she opened the bag at her hip and laid a notary's seal and three blank affidavits across the dashboard

value.name: Asha presents notary materials
value.description: Asha places a notary's seal and three blank affidavits on the dashboard for the others to see.
evidence: laid a notary's seal and three blank affidavits across the dashboard
Asha slid the three blank affidavits across the dashboard until they nudged the curve of the steering wheel

value.name: Lucia and Rosa hesitate
value.description: Neither Lucia nor Rosa immediately reaches for the papers, signaling reluctance or uncertainty.
evidence: Neither Lucia nor Rosa reached for the pages.

value.name: Lucia withdraws into herself
value.description: Lucia pulls her hand back to her empty cardigan pocket, reinforcing her hesitation.
evidence: Lucia's hand returned to the empty pocket of her cardigan

value.name: Rosa studies the seal
value.description: Rosa, now in the back seat, looks at the notary seal as if it had been anticipated all evening.
evidence: Rosa, in the back seat now, looked at the seal as if it were something that had been waiting in Asha's bag the whole evening they had been deciding what to do.

value.name: Asha insists on acting tonight
value.description: Asha says the signing must happen tonight rather than tomorrow, reframing the moment as urgent and decisive.
evidence: "Tonight," Asha said, low, "not tomorrow," and the word landed differently than she had meant it to, less a request than the shape of what the next hour would have to hold.

value.name: Asha invites someone to begin
value.description: Asha asks who will start, signaling that the affidavits are meant to be acted on now.

value.name: Lucia tests the papers
value.description: Lucia touches the top affidavit with two fingers, feeling its weight without taking it.
evidence: Lucia drew her hand out of the empty pocket at last and laid two fingers on the top page, not to take it, only to feel the weight of the paper against the vinyl

value.name: Lucia questions completeness
value.description: Lucia asks whether the affidavits and seal are everything, implying there may be more to the plan.
evidence: "Is this everything," without the lift of a question, as if she already knew the answer would be no and wanted to hear Asha say it anyway.

value.name: Rosa presses seal down
value.description: Rosa leans forward from the back seat and presses her palm over the notary seal, physically engaging with the documents.
evidence: From the back seat Rosa leaned forward between them and set her palm flat over the notary's seal, pressing it down against the dashboard
